ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels with high-intensity (white) linear disruptions; approximately 85:15 ratio of dark to light surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white linear clusters concentrated primarily on the lower-left lobe and medial sections of both lobes; white stippling along the proximal trailing edge margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute interior angle of approximately 65 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 units; more pronounced jaggedness on the distal third of both trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve along the medial trailing edge transitioning into a sharp upward concavity toward the distal tips (hooked tips).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct white circular and elliptical pixel clusters (1-5 pixel radius) scattered along the leading edge and distal extremities of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional, high-contrast white linear tracks (rake marks) crossing the ventral surface, most dense on the inner left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring across the entirety of the visible fluke surface; noticeable irregular chipping and indentations on the distal trailing edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an out-of-focus dorsal fin (delphinid or similar) positioned in the background between the central notch and the upper left lobe.
